title: Grandma Visits Saturday
can_do: 对家庭安排主动问出“谁来、几点、做什么”，并补上自己的想法。

conversation_move.label: ask who, when and what about a family plan

trigger: Mom announces a family plan without the details, so Child asks for who, when and what.
setting: A weekday morning at the kitchen table.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Grandma is visiting us on Saturday.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Just Grandma, and she stays for lunch.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Her train arrives at ten in the morning.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: What should I show her when she comes?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Your new drawing would make her happy.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I'll show the big rainbow one! Can we make pancakes for lunch?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Grandma loves pancakes. Good plan, sweetheart.

replay_cards.title: The dentist visit
replay_cards.setting: Mom says Child has a dentist appointment this week.
replay_cards.change: Child does not know when it is or who takes him.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks who takes him, what time, and what happens there, then adds one thing he wants to do afterward.

replay_cards.title: Cousin Max sleeps over
replay_cards.setting: The family plans for Max to sleep over on Friday.
replay_cards.change: The evening details are not set yet.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks where Max will sleep and what they will eat, and offers his own idea for morning games.

parent_support: 宣布计划时只说一半，把“谁来、几点”留给孩子问。
孩子问完细节后，问他“你想加什么”，让安排里有他的贡献。
把孩子的提议当真写进计划（比如薄煎饼午餐），让他体验问出来的效果。
